decisions.reason: The firm built this compliance tool itself, gave it its own page, and ties it to its announced agency and compliance direction, and the customer praise of its nearly 200 templates gives management reason to keep investing in it.
The management platform is featured on the home page and is central to the firm's agency-focused platform strategy, so the investment and public commitment make dropping it very unlikely.

This configurable hosting plan is close to the core offer, has its own page, and fits the scalable hosting promise, so the firm has little reason to withdraw it this early, even though the commitment is less prominent than for the platform.
